name: LiveFaceSwapVideo
tagline: Real-time AI webcam face swap in your browser, with no local GPU needed.
description: LiveFaceSwapVideo is a real-time AI face swap for your webcam: upload a portrait you have permission to use, open your camera, and see the swap live in your browser — no GPU needed. It also offers Live Try-On and Live Restyle. A Windows desktop virtual camera brings the output into OBS, Zoom and Google Meet.
